definition_zh: 祝福；祝祷；（礼拜结束时的）祝福祈祷
definition_en: a spoken blessing, especially one asking for God's favour and protection
core_image: 礼拜结束时牧师张开双手、向着人群说出的祝祷词
scene: 礼拜结束，众人低头，牧师张开双手诵出祝词。The priest raised his hands and gave the crowd his benediction.
sceneCN: 这里 benediction 是「祝福、祝祷」（第 1 个义项：正式说出的祝福语）；句意是牧师举手为人群祝福。

derivatives.zh: 由名词加后缀构成，义为「祝福的」
同根宗教用语，义为「祝文；赞美诗」
同义英语本族词，义为「祝福」

senses.title: A spoken blessing asking for divine favour
senses.definition: words asking for God's help and protection, said especially at the end of a service
senses.definitionCN: 祈求上帝护佑的话语，常见于礼拜结束时
senses.example: The priest raised his hands and gave the crowd his benediction.
senses.exampleCN: 牧师举起双手，为人群致祝祷。
senses.why: Bene means well and dicere means to speak, so it is good speech over people.
senses.whyCN: bene 意为「好」，dicere 意为「说」，合起来即「说吉利话于人身」。

senses.title: A happy event felt as a blessing
senses.definition: something that brings happiness or relief, as if sent from above
senses.definitionCN: 带来幸福或解脱的事，仿佛上天的恩赐
senses.example: The cool rain after the drought was a benediction on the fields.
senses.exampleCN: 旱后的凉雨落在田里，如同天赐之福。
senses.why: The good-speaking image widens to any goodness that seems heaven-sent.
senses.whyCN: 「说好话赐福」的意象扩大为一切像上天所赐的好处。

intro.en: Benediction is Latin bene, well, plus dicere, to speak.
intro.cn: benediction 由拉丁语 bene「好」加 dicere「说」构成。

items.en: the root deik- meant to point out, to pronounce.
items.cn: 词根 deik- 意为「指出、宣示」（重构形式）。

items.en: benedictio meant a speaking well of, a blessing.
items.cn: 拉丁语 benedictio 意为「说好话、祝福」。

items.en: benedicoun passed the word into medieval French usage.
items.cn: 古法语 benedicoun 使该词进入中世纪法语。

items.en: English borrowed benediction for church blessings.
items.cn: 十五世纪英语借入 benediction，用于教会祝福礼。

items.en: it also names figurative blessings in daily life.
items.cn: 如今也用于比喻日常生活中的福气。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the bene- root or dict- root; the near-meaning group gathers blessing words.
note.cn: 形近组共享 bene- 词根或 dict- 词根；近义组汇集祝福类词。

entries.definitionCN: 诅咒——前缀相反的对照词

entries.definition: one who gives help or money
entries.definitionCN: 恩人——同含 bene- 词根

entries.definition: to say words aloud for writing
entries.definitionCN: 口述——同含 dicere 词根

entries.definition: a prayer asking for favour, or a favour received
a short prayer of thanks before or after a meal
a prayer calling on God at the start of a service
entries.definitionCN: 祈求祷告——常在礼拜开始时，与结尾祝福相对

normalIntro.en: Benediction is bene plus dictio: good speech.
normalIntro.cn: benediction 是 bene 加 dictio：好话、祝福语。

normal.en: Malediction is its opposite, a curse.

normal.cn: benefactor 同含 bene- 词根。

normal.en: A benediction ends many church services.
Dicere also gives dictate and predict.
normal.cn: dicere 也派生出 dictate 与 predict。

abstract.en: See open palms lowered over bowed heads.
abstract.cn: 看张开的双手覆向低垂的头。

abstract.en: Feel warm light following the words.
Picture rain falling like kindness on dry fields.
abstract.cn: 想象善意如雨落在旱田。

examples.en: The priest raised his hands and gave the crowd his benediction.
examples.cn: 牧师举起双手，为人群致祝祷。

examples.en: The cool rain after the drought was a benediction on the fields.
examples.cn: 旱后的凉雨落在田里，如同天赐之福。

examples.en: Her last words to us were a quiet benediction.
examples.cn: 她留给我们的最后几句话是一声轻柔的祝福。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「杯你的神」——举杯为你、为你的神祝祷，满是祝福。

root: 拉丁语 bene「好地」加 dicere「说」，派生名词 benedictio「祝福、说好话」；词根 dicere 上溯至原始印欧语词根 deik-「指出、宣示」（重构形式），经古法语于十五世纪进入英语。同根词有 predict、dictate、malediction 等。

sensesIntro.en: One word moves from the priest's closing blessing to any gift that feels heaven-sent.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个词，从牧师收尾的祝祷，移向一切像上天所赐的好事。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: open palms lowered over bowed heads.
core.cn: 核心意象：张开的手掌覆向低垂的头。

intro.en: Benediction shows bene- doing good through the speech root dict-.
intro.cn: benediction 展示 bene- 借「说」词根 dict- 行善。

latinIntro.en: The Latin pair bene and dicere heads a wide family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 bene 与 dicere 的组合统领一个庞大家族。

items.meaning: to read aloud for writing; to command
to set apart for a purpose

latinEntries.meaning: a blessing, good speaking; direct source of benediction

derivatives.zh: 由名词加后缀构成，义为「祝福的」
同义变体，义为「祝福性的」
